title: Local Bounti Becomes Largest Leafy Greens CEA Grower in the U.S. with Completed Acquisition of Revol Greens' Certified-Organic Facilities

body_markdown:
*Local Bounti's growing footprint expands roughly 70%*


*FoodVentures, a Member of the DENSO Group, Local Bounti's Existing Strategic Investor and Other Investors Backed Completed Transaction*


HAMILTON, Mont.


, Nov. 24, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Local Bounti Corporation (NYSE: LOCL) ("Local Bounti" or the "Company"), a breakthrough U.S. indoor agriculture company currently servicing approximately 13,000 retail doors, today announced that it has completed the purchase of two certified-organic controlled environment agriculture (CEA) facilities from Revol Greens, located in Temple, Texas and Medford, Minnesota, as well as the Revol brand. The facilities bring 30 acres of certified-organic production and expand Local Bounti's assortment with a new organic offering for its retail customers.


Kathleen Valiasek, President and CEO of Local Bounti, commented, "We are excited to welcome the Revol Greens team to Local Bounti. Together, we are now the largest leafy greens CEA grower in the U.S. Demand for our products continues to outpace our capacity, and acquiring two operating facilities lets us meet that demand at a fraction of the cost and time of building new ones. Revol Greens has built strong, trusted relationships with retailers in markets that are new to us, and we are committed to building on that foundation. Organic is an important part of the assortment our retail partners want, and Revol's certified-organic greens broaden what we can offer them as a single grower."


The 20 acre Texas facility and the 10 acre Minnesota facility increase Local Bounti's growing footprint by roughly 70%, making it the largest leafy greens CEA grower in the U.S. as measured by greenhouse acreage. The Minnesota facility extends the Company's growing and distribution network into the Midwest, where Revol Greens has earned the trust of retail customers, and the Texas facility strengthens its existing presence in the Southern U.S. Additional capacity at the Texas facility is expected to support growth as that facility becomes sold out.


The transaction was backed by FoodVentures, part of the DENSO Group, Local Bounti's existing strategic investor and other investors. DENSO is one of the world's largest automotive technology suppliers, and it has been deliberately building its agriculture business since 2017, including through its investment in greenhouse provider Certhon and, this year, FoodVentures, a Netherlands-based developer and operator of high-tech greenhouses. As Dirk Aleven, CEO of FoodVentures put it, "Having operated these greenhouses day to day, I know what these facilities are capable of, and Local Bounti is the right home for them." The acquisition was funded primarily through secured notes, including new financing from Local Bounti's existing strategic investor, seller financing and assumed debt.


**About Local Bounti** Local Bounti is redefining indoor farming with an innovative method – its patented Stack & Flow Technology® – that significantly improves crop turns, increases output and improves unit economics. Local Bounti operates advanced indoor growing facilities across the United States, servicing approximately 13,000 retail doors. Local Bounti grows healthy food utilizing a hybrid approach that integrates the best attributes of controlled environment agriculture with natural elements. Local Bounti's sustainable growing methods are better for the planet, using 90% less land and 90% less water than conventional farming methods. With a mission to 'revolutionize agriculture, ensuring accessibility to fresh, sustainable, locally grown produce and nourishing communities everywhere for generations to come,' Local Bounti's food is fresher, more nutritious, and lasts longer than traditional agriculture. To find out more, visit localbounti.com or follow Local Bounti on LinkedIn for the latest news and developments.
